name: claude-ding
description: Audio notifications for Claude Code hooks: 17 synthesized WAVs and two afplay scripts (celebratory on Stop, question on AskUserQuestion / ExitPlanMode / PermissionRequest); plays sound on this Mac and writes nothing
hits: Claude Code hooks on this Mac (afplay; local audio only)
surface: two bash scripts the hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json run; every verb is read tier — a script picks a WAV and plays it through afplay; no file, setting, or network is touched. CLAUDE_DING_MUTE=1 is the dry run, CLAUDE_DING_VOLUME the only knob

origin.note: Source was dirty at vendor time: sounds/play-random.sh and sounds/play-random-question.sh had an uncommitted volume change (0.2 -> 0.1) that was already live in ~/.claude/sounds, so that value was carried by hand. Both scripts are rewritten here: sounds resolve relative to the script instead of a hard-coded ~/.claude/sounds path (so the belt copy works through the symlink or directly), CLAUDE_DING_VOLUME and CLAUDE_DING_MUTE were added. README install section replaced by toolbelt setup; tmp/ and .DS_Store not vendored.

install.description: Point ~/.claude/sounds at THIS tree's sounds/ so the hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json play the belt's copy
install.why: the hook commands are ~/.claude/sounds/play-random*.sh; a real directory there is a hand-copied snapshot that drifts from the belt every time a sound or volume changes
install.yes: ~/.claude/sounds -> {TOOLBELT}/tools/claude-ding/sounds; an existing real directory is renamed to ~/.claude/sounds.pre-toolbelt (never deleted), a stale link is replaced, a correct one is left alone; settings.json is not touched
install.no: skipped; the hooks keep playing whatever ~/.claude/sounds holds today; the doctor keeps warning

env.name: CLAUDE_DING_VOLUME
env.description: afplay volume 0.0-1.0 for both scripts; default 0.1 in the script

env.name: CLAUDE_DING_MUTE
env.description: Set to any value to print the chosen file and play nothing — the dry run; the smoke test exports it

auth.flow: none — afplay plays a local file as the operator; no credential, cache, or network

safeguards: Read-only by construction: sounds/play-random.sh and sounds/play-random-question.sh contain one afplay call each and no write of any kind; there is no verb that edits settings.json, copies files, or touches the network (SENSIBILITIES #1)
Dry run: CLAUDE_DING_MUTE=1 makes either script print the file it would play and exit 0 without opening the audio device (SENSIBILITIES #5)
Conservative default volume: 0.1 is the script constant; CLAUDE_DING_VOLUME overrides per invocation and nothing persists it (SENSIBILITIES #3)

Install touches one path outside the tree — the symlink action renames a real ~/.claude/sounds to .pre-toolbelt and never deletes; ~/.claude/settings.json is read by nothing here and written by nothing here (SENSIBILITIES #10)
Nothing secret in the tree: WAVs and two scripts; tmp/ and .DS_Store excluded (SENSIBILITIES #11)

verbs.name: play-random.sh
verbs.note: Stop hook: one of voila/sparkle/fanfare/crab through afplay at CLAUDE_DING_VOLUME (0.1)

verbs.name: play-random-question.sh
verbs.note: AskUserQuestion / ExitPlanMode / PermissionRequest hooks: one of question1-4 through afplay

verbs.name: hook registration in settings.json
verbs.note: no verb edits ~/.claude/settings.json; the operator adds the hook entries by hand (README shows the block)

checks.label: ~/.claude/sounds resolves to this tree's sounds/
checks.fix: Run: {TOOLBELT}/bin/toolbelt setup claude-ding — links ~/.claude/sounds here (a real dir is renamed to sounds.pre-toolbelt)

smoke_test.expect: both scripts pass bash -n and are executable; at least one .wav in sounds/; a CLAUDE_DING_MUTE=1 run of each script names an existing file — no audio is played

risk.worst_case: a short sound plays on this Mac's speakers at volume 0.1 (or whatever CLAUDE_DING_VOLUME says) when a hook fires; toolbelt setup renames an existing ~/.claude/sounds directory to .pre-toolbelt
